title: Top presents
objectives: express wants and preferences for gifts

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Top presents.
Welcome to today's lesson: Top presents! Today we will practice how to express wants and preferences for gifts.

elements.content: express wants and preferences for gifts; use want + noun / like + noun

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: gift, present, want, like, best

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: What present does the speaker want for birthday?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: I want a new computer for my birthday present. What gift do you want?

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
What do you want for your birthday? I want a book. The best present is spending time together.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Discuss top gift ideas for your friends and what presents you like most.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: express wants and preferences for gifts, use want + noun / like + noun.
